description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeDirectoryAPI in the OrangeHRM project. It contains test methods for API endpoints like getOne and getAll, as well as tests for unimplemented methods such as create, update, delete, and their validation rules. The class extends EndpointIntegrationTestCase and uses data providers to supply test cases from YAML files.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeDirectoryAPI, focusing on getOne, getAll, and unimplemented methods like create, update, delete, along with their validation rule methods.
